Select distinct compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1909046. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
